Pine Crossing is the store. Priyanka, on 9 June in #central-team you wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen.

I couldn't find its site. The shared files I can read have no Marrow Agrisupply account folder, and the Central notes I checked don't list store sites. The site will be in the Marrow account's CRM or tickets files, or in ticket PD-4821 (the Eastbank import). Those may need someone with access to the account folder, such as Hollis, who is handling setup for these stores.
